title: China's 'Special-Forces' Tourists: 10 Sights a Day, Sleep on the Train | China Travel Expert
description:
Young Chinese travellers invented a brutal way to see the country: 特种兵式旅游 — "special-forces tourism." The name borrows from punishing military training, because the pace is just as harsh: a whole city in 48 hours, up to ten sights in a single day. To save money you ride an overnight train, sleep sitting up, and start sightseeing at dawn; some skip hotels entirely and crash in 24-hour hotpot restaurants, bathhouses or internet cafes. A local student can even guide you through a full-city sprint for around 50 yuan — about $7 — an hour. It's mostly cash-strapped college students chasing the most trip for the least money. So which are you: a 48-hour sprint, or one city done slow?

★ Expert Tip: Book an overnight high-speed or sleeper train between cities — you save a hotel night AND wake up where you want to start the next day.

中国的年轻人发明了一种狠玩法：特种兵式旅游。名字来自高强度的军事训练，因为节奏一样狠——48 小时玩透一座城，一天最多打卡十个景点。为省钱，坐夜车、坐着睡、天一亮就开始逛；有人干脆不住酒店，睡在 24 小时火锅店、澡堂或网吧。找个本地大学生带你暴走全城，大约 50 元（约 7 美元）一小时。主力是没多少预算、想用最少钱玩最多地方的大学生。那么你是哪一种——48 小时冲刺，还是一座城慢慢逛？
—
I'm mapping ALL of China — real streets, real history, zero tourist traps.
🧭 Your China Travel Expert | 你的中国旅游专家

Facts verified 2026-11-27:
• "Special-forces tourism" (特种兵式旅游) means seeing as many sights and foods as possible with the least time and money; it's named after punishing military training because of the pace — CGTN https://news.cgtn.com/news/2023-05-04/-Special-Forces-style-Tourism-the-latest-fad-for-Chinese-youths-1jwTVxcZfCo/index.html + Daxue Consulting https://daxueconsulting.com/special-forces-tourism/
• To save money, travellers ride overnight / hard-seat trains and sleep in their seats, and some crash in 24-hour hotpot restaurants, bathhouses or internet cafes instead of hotels — CGTN https://news.cgtn.com/news/2023-05-04/-Special-Forces-style-Tourism-the-latest-fad-for-Chinese-youths-1jwTVxcZfCo/index.html + China Daily https://govt.chinadaily.com.cn/s/202307/24/WS64bdd444498ea274927c6104/tourists-on-a-mission-to-capture-scenic-glory.html
• Hiring a local student guide to speed-run a city is cheap — roughly 50 yuan (about $7 USD) an hour — and the travellers are mostly college students — Global Times https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202408/1318499.shtml + Daxue Consulting https://daxueconsulting.com/special-forces-tourism/

es.title: Los turistas 'fuerzas especiales' de China: 10 lugares al día, durmiendo en el tren
es.description: Los jóvenes chinos crearon el 特种兵式旅游, "turismo de fuerzas especiales": una ciudad entera en 48 horas y hasta 10 sitios en un día. Para ahorrar, viajan en tren nocturno, duermen sentados y empiezan al amanecer; algunos ni usan hotel. Un estudiante local te guía por la ciudad por unos 50 yuanes (~7 USD) la hora. ¿Sprint de 48 horas, o una ciudad con calma?

pt.title: Os turistas 'forças especiais' da China: 10 pontos por dia, dormindo no trem
pt.description: Os jovens chineses criaram o 特种兵式旅游, "turismo de forças especiais": uma cidade inteira em 48 horas e até 10 pontos num dia. Para economizar, pegam trem noturno, dormem sentados e começam ao amanhecer; alguns nem usam hotel. Um estudante local te guia pela cidade por cerca de 50 yuans (~US$7) a hora. Sprint de 48 horas, ou uma cidade com calma?

id.title: Turis 'pasukan khusus' China: 10 tempat sehari, tidur di kereta
id.description: Anak muda China menciptakan 特种兵式旅游, "wisata pasukan khusus": satu kota dalam 48 jam, hingga 10 tempat dalam sehari. Demi hemat, naik kereta malam, tidur sambil duduk, mulai saat fajar; sebagian tak pakai hotel. Pemandu mahasiswa lokal bisa menemanimu keliling kota sekitar 50 yuan (~$7) per jam. Sprint 48 jam, atau satu kota pelan-pelan?

hi.title: चीन के 'स्पेशल फोर्स' पर्यटक: दिन में 10 जगह, ट्रेन में नींद
hi.description: चीन के युवाओं ने 特种兵式旅游, यानी 'स्पेशल फोर्स टूरिज्म' बनाया: 48 घंटे में पूरा शहर, एक दिन में 10 तक जगहें। बचत के लिए रातभर की ट्रेन, बैठे-बैठे नींद, भोर से घूमना; कुछ होटल भी नहीं लेते। एक स्थानीय छात्र करीब 50 युआन (~$7) प्रति घंटे में पूरा शहर घुमा देता है। 48 घंटे की दौड़, या एक शहर आराम से?

ar.title: سياح 'القوات الخاصة' في الصين: 10 معالم في اليوم، والنوم في القطار
ar.description: ابتكر شباب الصين "سياحة القوات الخاصة" (特种兵式旅游): مدينة كاملة في 48 ساعة، وحتى 10 معالم في يوم واحد. توفيراً للمال يركبون قطاراً ليلياً وينامون جالسين ويبدأون عند الفجر؛ بعضهم لا يحجز فندقاً. يمكن لطالب محلي أن يرافقك في جولة المدينة بنحو 50 يواناً (~7 دولار) للساعة. سباق 48 ساعة، أم مدينة واحدة على مهل؟

fr.title: Les touristes 'forces spéciales' de Chine : 10 sites par jour, on dort dans le train
fr.description: Les jeunes Chinois ont inventé le 特种兵式旅游, le "tourisme forces spéciales" : une ville entière en 48 heures, jusqu'à 10 sites en un jour. Pour économiser : train de nuit, sommeil assis, visites dès l'aube ; certains évitent même l'hôtel. Un étudiant local vous guide dans toute la ville pour environ 50 yuans (~7 $) de l'heure. Sprint de 48 heures, ou une ville en prenant son temps ?
